summary: Read all 13 room pages and the targets (or their naming passages). Fourteen of the fifteen weak links carry a reason in one body sentence, almost always on the source side; eleven only needed a label; three are really other types (FOUR PILLARS to The Multilinear Self as mirrors, Oliveros to Cage as contradicts, Marcus to the Dichotomy as exemplifies); one is cut (AI Partnership Philosophy to Palace Enchantment, no reason on either page). Pattern: the bare connects-to links were nearly all body-justified citations, just never labeled; the one true orphan was a copy of a link its parent already held. I did not settle whether the Multilinear Self mirror belongs on FOUR PILLARS or only as a Multilinear Self outbound (the hub never says it; only the target does), and the Oliveros/Cage retype is a judgment that foil means contradiction rather than complement. I proposed no typed relations, health flags or lighter-prose changes: nothing in these pages rose to them. Pages with an unlabeled Loudon Live link elsewhere in the room (e.g. Founding Conversation, AI Partnership) were outside my list and left alone.
